articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: CFTC sues Utah to block action against prediction markets
articles.description: The US state filed a lawsuit against Kalshi last week, seeking to recover up to $60 million in profits related to event contracts on prediction markets.

articles.title: AI Agents Are Creating a New Layer of Cybersecurity Spending
articles.description: Akamai launched a locked box for AI agents on Tuesday. It joins Palo Alto, Cisco, CrowdStrike, Okta and Zscaler in selling protection for software that now acts on its own.

articles.title: U.S. agency hits Utah with lawsuit to shield Kalshi's ability to offer betting there
articles.description: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission has pursued more than a dozen legal actions to protect what its chief sees as its sole power over prediction markets.

articles.title: Intel, Oracle, IBM Join Objections to OKX-ICE Tokenized Stock Venue, Bringing Total to 26
articles.description: Intel, Oracle, IBM, and IonQ became the latest companies to object to trading of their shares on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, bringing the total to 26.

articles.title: Bitcoin Wallet Maker Keystone Pulls Devices as Stolen Key Opens Door to Fakes
articles.description: Attackers obtained the factory key that proves Keystone's hardware wallets are genuine, and 25,964 buyer records were affected. The company says recovery phrases and private keys were not involved.

articles.title: Intel, Oracle, IBM join growing list of firms objecting to OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans
articles.description: The latest notice added four objections, bringing the total to 26 as the joint venture prepares to test the SEC’s new framework for blockchain-based stock trading.

articles.title: Majority of Americans want candidates who support US-based financial technology: Poll
articles.description: The September survey offered a possible window into US voters who could consider fintech and digital asset policies on Election Day.

articles.title: Circle Pushes Deeper Into Latin America With USDC Settlement in Colombia
articles.description: A collaboration with payments-tech firm ACI Worldwide will pilot folding USDC settlement into Colombia’s instant-payments network.

articles.title: Brazilian companies turned to stablecoins on election day to dodge a currency crash
articles.description: USDT volume on crypto exchange Mercado Bitcoin jumped nearly 800% and bitcoin volume surged 865%. Binance’s USDT/BRL market tripled while the global BTC/USDT pair fell.

articles.title: A $3M Hedge, a Midterm Test and Retail's Rise: Prediction Markets at NEXTPredict
articles.description: Chuck Todd called markets a "fact checker" for journalism, as Kalshi, Polymarket and Robinhood pitched contracts well beyond elections.

articles.title: OpenAI Proves ETH Is False, and Crypto Twitter Has Questions
articles.description: A new OpenAI paper declares ETH false, a claim that hundreds of research papers lean on. Crypto Twitter degens and serious mathematicians are abuzz.

articles.title: Janus Henderson, Centrifuge launch tokenized Nasdaq-100 fund on Stellar
articles.description: The blockchain-based fund offers eligible non-US investors exposure to the Nasdaq-100 as Janus Henderson expands its institutional tokenization business.

articles.title: Robinhood taps Ripple’s $2.5 billion RLUSD stablecoin despite backing rival USDG
articles.description: Robinhood helped launch a rival dollar-backed token, USDG, but will also offer Ripple's stablecoin to retail customers later this year.

articles.title: USDC overtakes USDT in euro stablecoin trading as EU rules reshape market: Kaiko
articles.description: USDC’s share of euro stablecoin trading has climbed to 56% since January 2024, with deeper liquidity as exchanges restrict USDT under MiCA.

articles.title: McDonald's McRib Doesn't Actually Boost Bitcoin's Price, Sorry Everyone
articles.description: Crypto traders think the McRib’s return to McDonald's means a Bitcoin pump is coming. Experts say there is "no correlation at all."

articles.title: Nasdaq-100 comes onchain as Janus Henderson and Centrifuge launch first licensed fund
articles.description: The $500 billion asset manager is launching an issuer-sponsored fund on Stellar, taking a different approach from third-party stock tokens.

articles.title: CF Benchmarks brings Wall Street pricing infrastructure onchain, including data used by BlackRock
articles.description: The new service could help developers build blockchain-based index funds, tokenized portfolios and derivatives using established financial benchmarks.

articles.title: Polymarket Has Investigated 'Dozens' of Midterm Election Bets: Report
articles.description: The firm's new head of investigations says its surveillance system flags hundreds of alerts a day, with at least two cases sent to the CFTC.

articles.title: Crypto could outperform AI stocks: Wall Street veteran Jordi Visser
articles.description: Former Morgan Stanley and Weiss executive Jordi Visser says AI agents are boosting demand for crypto as he expands his holdings beyond Bitcoin, Ether and Solana.

articles.title: Bitcoin miners' move into AI is creating a new market for trading computing power
articles.description: Luxor raised $16 million to expand into AI hardware and trading, betting that computing power will become a market where companies can hedge costs and prices.

articles.title: Hayes details FLOP’s AI compute derivatives vision after selling his altcoins
articles.description: Arthur Hayes revealed the derivatives market design for Flop Network and how he expects its native token could transform AI compute into a tradable commodity.

articles.title: Bitcoin Mining Firm Luxor Raises $16 Million to Scale Its AI Compute Push
articles.description: The CMT Digital-led round, which drew mining-hardware makers Canaan and MicroBT, will fund Luxor’s expansion into AI compute trading, hardware and derivatives.

articles.title: Luxor raises $16M from CMT Digital amid AI-Bitcoin miner convergence
articles.description: Luxor aims to use the proceeds to scale its existing AI infrastructure business and expand its GPU sourcing services as global chip supply chains become constrained.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Tokenized Stock Battle Looms Over Robinhood’s Earnings Call
articles.description: One of crypto’s primary growth sectors for this upcoming cycle is under attack. Will Vlad Tenev speak up on today’s Robinhood earnings call?

articles.title: Bitcoin price analysis sees ‘strong rally’ as old coins become dormant
articles.description: A decline in the share of Bitcoin’s realized cap held by coins unmoved for 18 months or longer points to the ‘early stages’ of a bull market, analysis says.

articles.title: Bitcoin shows signs of weakness while Ripple's bank win fails to bolster XRP
articles.description: Your day-ahead look for Oct. 27, 2026

articles.title: Why This Team of Ninjas Is Tripling Down on Mining Bitcoin
articles.description: NIP Group says Bitcoin mining has “earned its place” as the esports giant swaps 247 million shares for more machines.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin holds near $80,000 as AI buildout draws investor attention and capital
articles.description: Interest rates and oil are slipping and equities are rising, but crypto remains under pressure.

articles.title: Japan's top yen stablecoin falls short of its target in a disappointing first year
articles.description: CEO Noritaka Okabe blamed a 1 million yen per-transaction cap for Type II funds transfer providers, which has slowed corporate adoption.

articles.title: Bitcoin drops below $80,000 as crypto ignores Asian tech rally, Fed meeting begins
articles.description: Bitcoin fell 0.4% to around $79,700 since midnight UTC while Asian tech stocks rallied. The DeFi index dropped 1.8%, and the Fed is set to begin a two-day meeting.

articles.title: Crypto wallet maker Keystone to destroy almost 19,000 devices after security breach
articles.description: The breach exposed 25,964 buyer records, some kept past Keystone’s 180-day deletion policy after an automated tool failed without the firm noticing.

articles.title: Investor who called for AI pivot in 2023 says bitcoin is going to $57,000
articles.description: Jason Calacanis wants investors to sell bitcoin and back artificial intelligence. He is also holding TAO, the cryptocurrency behind AI network Bittensor.

articles.title: Ripple Wins Final OCC Approval for Trust Bank Behind $2.6B RLUSD Stablecoin
articles.description: The federally supervised bank will manage RLUSD's reserves and offer custody, as banking groups fight crypto charters in court.

articles.title: Zcash co-founder calls to stop funding ‘over $125M’ grants program
articles.description: Sean Bowe says ZCG has enough money to keep funding projects and wants its share of new ZEC redirected to a reserve for the network.

articles.title: Now is the time to accumulate bitcoin, Galaxy says
articles.description: Galaxy argues improving price trends, resilient ETF demand and rising U.S. debt support bitcoin’s recovery towards its previous high.

articles.title: Bloom bot hackers loot $953K faster than you can microwave popcorn
articles.description: Bloom pledged to reimburse nine traders after $953,000 was drained from 48 wallets, saying no private keys were accessed or compromised.

articles.title: An AI label alone no longer wins lenders, JPMorgan says
articles.description: As default insurance on several AI-linked firms hits record costs, companies must show they can finance investment, service the debt and eventually mint cash, JPMorgan says.

articles.title: Binance files for Brazil crypto license ahead of Friday deadline
articles.description: The exchange is delisting 22 crypto assets for Brazilian users and hopes talks with the central bank will allow it to restore some services.

articles.title: Solana bug reports now cost 1 SOL as AI floods security teams with spam
articles.description: Researchers must now permanently burn 1 SOL for every submission after a monthlong contest drew 809 reports, with AI believed to have helped generate or write nearly all of them.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs claw back $110M after $774M exit
articles.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs remained in the red for October, with about $202 million in net outflows for the month despite Monday’s rebound.

articles.title: Ethereum fixes Glamsterdam bug that could have sent staking deposits to builders
articles.description: Developers initially rejected the change before reversing course, as testing delays gave them more time to examine a flaw in Ethereum's upcoming Glamsterdam upgrade.

articles.title: Zcash co-founder proposes ending grants funding, citing $125 million treasury
articles.description: Sean Bowe’s proposal would send the committee’s 8% share of newly created ZEC to a reserve for future miners. The committee would keep the money it has already received.

articles.title: Ripple gets a final go-ahead to launch its own U.S. national trust bank
articles.description: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency has approved Ripple National Trust Bank (RNTB), Ripple's CEO Brad Garlinghouse announced on X.

articles.title: RedotPay weighs confidential US IPO filing by year-end: Bloomberg
articles.description: The stablecoin payments company previously disputed reports that its US listing had been delayed.

articles.title: Keystone breach deepens: Hackers stole key used to verify wallets as genuine
articles.description: Keystone initially disclosed a leak of customer information but has since disclosed that hackers also stole a key that could allow counterfeit wallets to pass authenticity checks.

articles.title: Ripple wins final US approval for national trust bank
articles.description: The approval clears the way for Ripple to manage reserves backing its RLUSD stablecoin and provide digital asset custody.

articles.title: Canada’s Draft Stablecoin Rules Cap Redemption Fees at 1% and Ban Yield
articles.description: Ottawa opened a 60-day consultation on draft rules requiring one-to-one reserves and fast redemption from stablecoin issuers, while keeping the ban on paying holders interest.

articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6.1 Terra, Its Half-Good AI Model at Half the Price
articles.description: OpenAI's mid-tier model now operates apps and screens more like a person would, with API prices 50% below GPT-5.6 Terra and an error rate that OpenAI says fell sharply.

articles.title: US OCC calls on community banks to become payment stablecoin issuers
articles.description: The announcement followed the banking regulator finalizing its rules for the GENIUS Act, a stablecoin law to be implemented in January

articles.title: Injective launches onchain futures market tracking Nvidia GPU rental costs
articles.description: The new index tracks rental prices for five Nvidia GPUs, offering leveraged trading and potential hedging against fluctuations in AI computing costs.

articles.title: Unitree Stock Jumps as Investors Bet Chatbot AI Will Finally Give Robots a Brain
articles.description: Unitree's shares have jumped about 60% in under two weeks as investors bet OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra will give robots the brains they lack, turning the stock into an AI proxy.

articles.title: NBA Embraces the CFTC on Prediction Markets as the NFL Fights It in Court
articles.description: The agreement, which follows similar deals with MLB and NHL, establishes information-sharing to guard against insider trading as sports betting migrates to CFTC-regulated venues.

articles.title: South Korea Arrests Seven in First Big AI-Assisted Hacking Case
articles.description: Police in Seoul say a 32-year-old with no IT background used AI tools to break into about 90 hospitals, schools and companies, then pressed victims for roughly $270,000 combined.

articles.title: Canada opens consultation on stablecoins, citing US GENIUS Act
articles.description: As part of the potential implementation of its Stablecoin Act, the Canadian government will hear from the public on a proposed framework for tokens from non-financial institutions.

articles.title: AI Agents Found a Way Into Anthropic's Business Systems in Under 12 Hours
articles.description: Cathedral, a startup founded by ex-DOGE staffers, says its AI agents found paths into Anthropic's sales, HR, and IT systems through third-party software.

articles.title: Why Prediction Markets Got the Brazilian Election So Wrong
articles.description: Experts say Brazil's prediction market ban left the odds in the hands of traders with little knowledge about the election.

articles.title: AI company Anthropic announces IPO, expected as early as November
articles.description: The artificial intelligence company disclosed more than $16 billion in revenue and an $80 billion net loss for the first half of 2026.

articles.title: SpaceX Locks Up $40 Billion for AI Chips as Musk Warns Most Neoclouds Will Die
articles.description: Elon Musk says SpaceX closed a $40 billion chip deal with Apollo while lenders shut the door on smaller AI cloud firms, a split that could decide who controls computing.

articles.title: NBA names Kalshi, Polymarket preferred exchanges, signs CFTC deal
articles.description: The US professional basketball league is expanding into prediction markets with official data agreements and safeguards against insider trading.

articles.title: Bitcoin Wallet Fixes Critical Flaw That Redirected Funds to Attackers
articles.description: A confirmed exploit let rogue servers replace Electrum’s pending transactions, tricking users into redirecting Bitcoin to attacker addresses.

articles.title: India’s CoinDCX Confirms $16 Million Loss Days After CEO Called It a ‘False Alarm’
articles.description: The Mumbai-based exchange says 15.99 million USDT was drained from wallets it retired after last year’s $44 million hack, bringing its combined losses to nearly $60 million—and it’s absorbing the hit.

articles.title: South Korea lawmakers mull pushing crypto tax implementation to 2029
articles.description: The Seoul government is reportedly weighing another delay for a 2020 income tax policy on digital assets, citing concerns with receiving data from US officials.

articles.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine favors share buybacks to ether purchases as crypto declines
articles.description: The Ethereum treasury firm spent $46 million buying back shares as Chairman Tom Lee said crypto has held up better than AI stocks during the recent market pullback.

articles.title: Brazil’s Stock Market Crashes After Lula’s Upset Victory
articles.description: The iShares Brazil ETF fell as much as 26% after Lula da Silva beat Flávio Bolsonaro, who prediction markets had at 80%, while the dollar jumped as much as 12% against the real.

articles.title: NBA joins pro sports leagues on CFTC prediction markets bandwagon while NFL balks
articles.description: The U.S. derivatives regulator, which has championed the arrival of prediction market firms such as Kalshi, has been gathering allied sports leagues.

articles.title: Kalshi strikes deal with S&P Dow Jones Indices to expand financial event contracts
articles.description: The agreement adds S&P Dow Jones gauges to a growing list of Wall Street firms expanding their involvement in prediction markets.

articles.title: OCC calls on community banks to enter the stablecoin payments market
articles.description: The U.S. banking regulator is encouraging smaller lenders to develop stablecoin services as new federal licensing requirements approach.

articles.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine Keeps Buying Ethereum But Pivots to Record Share Buybacks
articles.description: The firm added 10,452 ETH to reach 4.95% of supply, but its bigger move was repurchasing 2.04 million of its own shares—part of what it calls the largest equity buyback any crypto treasury company has run.

articles.title: 'Privacy Horror’: Researcher Uncovers Extent of Samsung Smart TV User Tracking
articles.description: AI-powered reverse engineering could make it "easier and faster" for researchers to uncover and explain how devices collect and share data.

articles.title: South Korea weighs fourth delay on its crypto gains tax, pushing it to 2029
articles.description: Officials are concerned users of domestic exchanges would bear the tax burden because the U.S. won’t share crypto trading data until 2029.

articles.title: PHP flaw shows AI ‘vulnerability apocalypse’ is on schedule: Immunefi CEO
articles.description: Mitchell Amador warned internet users that websites could remain compromised for weeks, particularly smaller websites slower to adopt the emergency upgrades.

articles.title: Canada opens consultation on draft stablecoin rules, maintains ban on yields
articles.description: Under the draft rules, non-bank stablecoin issuers must back tokens 1:1 with reserves held at qualified Canadian institutions and settle redemptions within three business days.

articles.title: Anthropic Makes IPO Filing Public, Plans Nasdaq Listing Under ‘ANT’
articles.description: The S-1 shows revenue up from $1.2 billion a year earlier, and a share structure that leaves a trust and the co-founders in control.

articles.title: Strategy skips Bitcoin purchases, spends $205M on STRC buybacks
articles.description: Strategy made no Bitcoin purchases or sales last week, as its STRC preferred stock buybacks reduced its USD Cash balance by 46% to $242.4 million.

articles.title: Strategy Pauses Bitcoin Buying, Spends $205M Buying Back STRC
articles.description: The Bitcoin treasury firm's USD Cash balance fell to $242.4 million after its biggest weekly STRC buyback in more than a month.

articles.title: AI giant Anthropic files for blockbuster IPO
articles.description: The maker of Claude reported $16.3 billion in first-half revenue and an $80.7 billion net loss as it aims to price its offering in mid-November.

articles.title: HOOD’s prediction markets to add $1.7B to revenue, exceed crypto by 2028: Bernstein
articles.description: Bernstein analysts raised Robinhood’s revenue estimates through 2026 and 2028, while maintaining their HOOD price target unchanged at $160.

articles.title: Bitcoin Dips Below $80,000 Ahead of Fed Decision, Midterms
articles.description: Analysts point to a sell-off in AI stocks and ETF outflows, with HashKey's Tim Sun flagging $75,000 as the next key support level.

articles.title: Bitcoin’s Bear Market Is Over, Galaxy Research Says: 'Now Is an Attractive Time to Buy'
articles.description: Galaxy Research says Bitcoin’s bear market ended in June, pointing to a reclaimed 50-week moving average, fading selling pressure, and a strengthening debasement case.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Bitcoin Breaks Below $80,000 as Iran Fears Hit the Weekend
articles.description: Some relief is appearing this morning as oil and rates fall, with a big macro week ahead featuring major earnings, FOMC and key data drops.

articles.title: Aviva Investors launches tokenized share class of $29B Sterling fund on XRP Ledger
articles.description: The move marks Aviva’s second fund to list tokenized shares, part of a broader collaboration to bring more tokenized funds to the XRP Ledger.

articles.title: Israel's Central Bank Rebukes Netanyahu Plan to Use Crypto to Dodge Sanctions
articles.description: Over 100 economists, including former governor Jacob Frenkel, warned of deeper isolation ahead of Israel's October 27 national election.

articles.title: BTC price risks $80K loss into FOMC, earnings: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
articles.description: Bitcoin bulls fought for $80,000 support over the weekend ahead of a heavy week of US tech earnings and inflation data.

articles.title: Securitize’s tokenized stock value halves as Circle widens lead
articles.description: SECZ’s onchain market cap fell to $208.6 million as Circle-linked tokens reached a combined $383.6 million across several issuers in the $3.3 billion tokenized equities market.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs break 2-week outflow streak with $301M comeback
articles.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs finished the week with $301 million in net inflows after a strong three-day start gave way to heavy withdrawals.

articles.title: Wells Fargo, Cisco, Intuit Among 6 More Companies Objecting to Tokenized Stocks
articles.description: Twenty-two companies have now objected to having their shares traded on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, after Wells Fargo, Cisco, Marvell, Arm, Moderna. and Intuit joined the list.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs Snap Two-Week Losing Streak Despite Late-Week Slide
articles.description: Spot Bitcoin ETFs finished the week with about $301 million in net inflows, ending a two-week losing streak, even as two straight days of outflows kept October in the red.

articles.title: Google Quietly Updates Privacy Policy to Let Gmail and Photos Data Feed Ads
articles.description: A policy change effective Oct. 16 carves out an exception to Google’s long-standing pledge—letting connected Gmail, Drive, and Photos data personalize ads through its Personal Intelligence AI features.

articles.title: Sweden's Government Offices Block ChatGPT and Claude, Keep Microsoft Copilot
articles.description: Sweden's Government Offices will block ChatGPT and Claude on staff computers from Monday, steering civil servants to Microsoft Copilot as the only AI that passed its security review.
